thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a short run of kernel attention experiments next week. Goal: compare FlashAttention v2, our paged-attn prototype, and fused-op toggles across seq lengths (2k / 8k / 32k). Need throughput (tokens/s), p50/p99, mem, and traces. Who can take point?

james: I can run microbench sweeps on an 8xA100 node. Need the matrix and which PR to test. Also what's the primary metric — tokens/sec or latency?

maria: tokens/s primary; capture p50/p99 and peak GPU memory. Also collect KV cache hit ratio. Target is ~20% throughput uplift vs baseline to call it a win.

anita: Ping me the PRs when ready — I'll do code review for the fused-kernel changes. Which branches?

maria: PR #4123 is the fused-ops change, PR #4130 is the paged-attn allocator tweak.

devbot: CI started for PR #4123 — 3/7 checks running.

james: I'll schedule runs tonight. Need a reserved node for ~2 hours. @ops_lead can you reserve test-node-4 for 11pm-1am PST?

ops_lead: reserved test-node-4 for 11pm-1am PST. Please include exact run commands & expected artifacts.

sahil: Observability ask: enable tracing with --enable-kernel-trace and collect perf counters L2_misses and DRAM_bw; NVTX ranges around attention would be very helpful. I'll add histograms/dashboards.

maria: Example commands to run (copy/paste):
```
./runtimectl bench --model llama-2-13b --seq 2048 --bsz 1 --profile kernel --out results/flash_v2_seq2k.json
./runtimectl bench --model llama-2-13b --seq 8192 --bsz 1 --profile kernel --paged-attn --out results/paged_seq8k.json
```
Include --quant-mode=q4f for a quantized sweep. Name artifacts with the timestamp.

james: ack. I'll run both and upload logs to /tmp/bench-1802500000/ and attach perf.data and nvtx traces.

anita: also include a small repro snippet that triggers the fused path so I can test locally before the CI run.

maria: repro snippet: 
```
input = 'a' * 6000
out = runtime.generate(input, max_tokens=512, use_fused=True)
```
This should hit the fused kernel if it's enabled.

devbot: CI update — PR #4123: tests/bench smoke: PASSED ; integration: running.

sahil: one more: capture kernel-level timing breakdown (attention setup vs compute vs io) so we can attribute wins correctly. NVPROF / nsight ranges around attention compute are fine.

james: will do. Timeline: starts 11pm, expect artifacts + a short summary by ~2am. I'll post numbers (tokens/s, p50, p99, mem) and attach traces.

anita: I'll aim to finish the review this afternoon and post any requested changes before the run.

maria: thanks — if anyone hits a regression, tag me and open an eval in Redwood Optimize with promptset 'long-seq-regress'. :thumbsup:
